title: Stargate within the mesa

tellings.quote: Hey, so imagine if there's a stargate within the mesa,

plain: On a podcast episode with the owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a property in Utah known for reports of strange happenings, a speaker invites listeners to imagine that there is a stargate, a kind of doorway to somewhere else, inside the mesa on the ranch. It is offered as a possible explanation for what people say goes on there.
